messages:
Olivia: quick idea — I keep hitting an intermittent double-evict on prefetched prefixes when a tenant surge collides with demote+handoff. Can't reproduce locally reliably. Error looks like:

Olivia:
```
E eviction: prefix=tenant/42/foo kv=evict double-apply detected: handoff_seq=153 -> already demoted
stack: runtime::prefetch::demote
```

Sam: hmm. do we have deterministic sequencing for demote vs handoff? sounds like race between demote committing tombstone vs handoff applying

Priya: can we add a test harness that replays a deterministic op stream? i.e., inject monotonically increasing op ids and deterministic scheduling to reproduce orderings. also add a metric 'prefix.eviction.owner_seq' to snapshot ownership state

Diego: I'll volunteer to run a sweep. can you share the minimal core dump/repro script? @Olivia

Olivia: pushing a small spike: run `./tools/evict_repro --seed 42 --tenant 42 --burst 500 --pause-ms 5` — it's in my branch. plan:
- add `--deterministic-opids` to harness (default off)
- capture `ownership_snapshot` on any double-evict
- add debug flag `REPRO_CAPTURE=/tmp/evict_repro` to dump lease table

Sam: :thinking: low-risk if flag default off. also add telemetry tag so we can filter in console

ci-bot: unit-test evict_repro (seed=42) failed on linux/amd64 — reproducer produced double-evict, attached /tmp/evict_repro.tar.gz :warning:

Priya: if CI already reproduces, can we make a minimal deterministic unit test and gate on it? also think about adding a lightweight invariant check that rejects double-apply (fail fast) — to get a stack trace where it first happens

Diego: running locally now. if it's quick I can iteratively narrow timing window and try seeds

Olivia: next steps: I'll open PR with harness + capture logic + invariants, will include a small doc (in PR body) with commands to run. If CI reproduces, we'll schedule a pairing to root-cause. thanks :party_parrot:

Sam: one more ask — include a flag to emit compact JSON snapshots (owner_seq, lease_epoch, inflight_ops) so we can feed into our simulator later

Priya: noted. Also let's ensure we tag the snapshot with git rev and build id so tests are traceable

Diego: on it, will report back in this thread.
